name: Suhaan Khurana
tagline: Software, systems, and a notebook of ideas.
bio: I’m Suhaan, a data science student at UC San Diego. I build software, explore AI and systems, and use this space to work through ideas in writing.
about: I’m studying data science at the University of California, San Diego. My work spans AI applications, software infrastructure, and the systems that connect them.

I like understanding how things work, then building something to test that understanding. That has taken me from retrieval systems and research tools to real-time software and open-source machine learning.
This site is a home for longer essays, short notes, and things I’m still figuring out. Some ideas will be polished. Others will stay open-ended.

experience.description: Building AI-assisted research tools and software for engineering workflows.
Worked on retrieval systems and product features that help people navigate complex information.
Worked on real-time control software for autonomous underwater systems.

openSource: I’ve also contributed to FastVideo and explored efficient language modeling through OpenAI Parameter Golf.
